resources.string: Which Bluetooth should this wireless connection use?
Choose external Bluetooth or the car Bluetooth first, then choose the iPhone. Both stay available.
External Bluetooth
Car Bluetooth
Use external Bluetooth
Choose iPhone · %1$s · %2$s
Choose iPhone · %1$s
Check again
Pair the iPhone to the external adapter first. The line above says which step it is on; the phone appears here once it is paired.
External Bluetooth is running on the connection screen. That screen shows the step it is stuck on.
Wireless is not ready
The hotspot name and password are not saved. Open connection setup, enter the car hotspot name and password, and save.
The car hotspot is off. Open the car hotspot settings and turn the hotspot on. Use 5 GHz when it is offered. The name and password must match what DiPlay saved.
Bluetooth is not chosen yet. In step 2 pick external Bluetooth or the car Bluetooth, then pick the phone. External Bluetooth pairs to the adapter’s name; car Bluetooth pairs to the car.
Bluetooth is chosen, but the iPhone is not. Pick your phone from the list in step 2.

Car Bluetooth is selected, but it is off or this app cannot read it. Open the car Bluetooth settings, turn Bluetooth on, and pair this iPhone. If this car has no Bluetooth data socket, choose external Bluetooth for wireless.
No external Bluetooth adapter was found. Plug it into the armrest USB port, allow DiPlay to use it, then check again.
External Bluetooth is not plugged in, so startup has not begun. Plug the adapter into the armrest USB port, then check again.

External Bluetooth is plugged in. Startup is stuck on USB permission. If a prompt asks to let DiPlay use the USB device, tap Allow. If no prompt appears, unplug the adapter, plug it back in, and check again.
USB permission is granted. Startup is stuck on opening the adapter. Unplug it, plug it back in, and check again.
Startup is stuck on taking the adapter. Another program is holding it. Unplug it, close the other program, plug it back in, and check again.
Startup is stuck on finding a Bluetooth interface. This adapter has no usable Bluetooth port. Use a classic Bluetooth adapter.
The adapter is present and startup has not begun. Tap Check again.
Startup has not finished. It is stuck on reset. Wait a few seconds and check again. If it stays here, unplug the adapter and plug it back in.
Startup has not finished. It is stuck on broadcasting the name %1$s. Unplug the adapter and plug it back in, then check again.
The car hotspot is off, so the adapter is not broadcasting yet. Turn the hotspot on in the car settings, then come back. Pair the iPhone after the name appears.

Startup is working and the adapter is broadcasting %1$s. The connection flow is not done. It is stuck on pairing. On the iPhone open Settings, Bluetooth, Other Devices, and tap that name. Do not tap the car Bluetooth entry.
Startup is working. Pairing is in progress. Confirm it on the iPhone.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck on pairing because the phone did not finish. On the iPhone, forget this device, then tap %1$s again.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck because no iPhone is paired yet. Pair it, then connect.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck opening the Bluetooth link to the iPhone. Bring the phone closer, make sure it is paired to %1$s, and connect again.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck on Bluetooth encryption. The pairing key does not match. On the iPhone, forget %1$s and pair it again.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck looking for the iPhone CarPlay Bluetooth service. The phone must be paired to %1$s, not to the car Bluetooth. Forget it, pair again, and retry.
Startup is working. The flow is stuck opening the iAP2 data channel. Forget %1$s on the iPhone, pair it again, and connect.
Startup is working and the iAP2 channel is open.
Startup is working and this iPhone is paired on the external adapter. You can connect.
External Bluetooth failed to start (%1$s). Unplug the adapter, plug it back in, and check again.
No iPhone is on the car Bluetooth yet. On the car Bluetooth page connect this iPhone for phone or music, then choose it here.
